title: The separate repository-pressure recovery left the candidate gain unresolved
summary: The original addendum failed before serving. A separately authorized recovery completed eighteen configurations, including four complete four-system pressure blocks. Candidate versus ARC remained inconclusive.
scope: Every ARC pressure block had 25 eviction-affected returns. All 288 finals and selected 272 source-review items were audited.
limitations: The recovery is a separate experiment and does not erase the failed attempt. Four blocks do not establish a general winner; quality equivalence remains unproved.
decision: Keep the failed original and completed recovery distinct. Do not call an unresolved gain either a win or proof of equivalence.

chart.caption: Four complete pressure blocks; original paired 95% intervals. Above 1 is faster. External systems differ in runtime and outputs.
